summary: On the main deck, the monitors suddenly activate. Trinity screams in response to this event. Tank and Morpheus look at each other, and the narrator describes the moment as a miracle. Trinity then commands someone to get up.

what_changes.before: inactive or dark (implied by 'jump back to life')
expecting failure or death (implied by the miracle description)

event_hint.one_line: The monitors restart, prompting Trinity to urge the patient to rise.
